# Final Audit Checklist

Use this file in Phase 06.

## Required final confirmations

1. Every major PRD requirement is represented.
2. Every requirement is assigned to a phase.
3. Phase order is technically coherent.
4. Phase dependencies are explicit.
5. Sequential execution rule was enforced.
6. Context-management rules were followed.
7. UI/UX quality rules were enforced.
8. Testing and verification standards were enforced.
9. Security requirements were enforced.
10. End-to-end completion is achievable and verified through this system.

- Blocked organiser access denial verified.
- Refresh-token revocation verified.
- Unauthorized mutation denial verified.
- Multilingual content completeness verified.
- Public navigation correctness verified.
- Audit log presence and completeness verified.
- Dataset version integrity verified.
